record.question: Which Indian journalist has won the 2018 London Press Freedom Award for Courage?
record.explanation: Answer D: Swati Chaturvedi. Reporters Without Borders’ announcement of the 2018 Press Freedom Awards names Swati Chaturvedi in the Courage category. Reference: https://rsf.org/en/journalists-malta-india-philippines-and-uk-honoured-reporters-without-borders-2018-press-freedom. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: February 2019 (cover page; no day given). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
